title: NASA HDF4 granules from GHRC DAAC
description: One small granule per selected collection from NASA's GHRC DAAC cloud archive (GHRC_DAAC in CMR), chosen to cover distinct products. Each item links to its CMR granule and collection records. The HDF4 files in this collection remain under their source's terms, linked from this collection and set out in THIRD-PARTY.md. The answer keys and STAC metadata are descriptions generated by this project and dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0); they do not alter the terms of the files they describe.
license_note: Each granule carries its collection's terms as recorded in NASA CMR; see the item's cmr:terms
